## Fix applied: boolean weights in weighted mean (GH4074)

**Root cause** — `Weighted._sum_of_weights` in `xarray/core/weighted.py` computes `dot(da.notnull(), weights)`. With boolean weights, both operands are bool, so `np.einsum` performs a logical-AND reduction: `xr.dot([True,True], [True,True])` → `True` (1), not `2`. The mean then divides by 1
